docs.title: Pan Guancheng — AI Agent Researcher
docs.text:
Zhejiang University · Hangzhou 潘冠成Pan Guancheng

Student · Independent AI Agent Researcher · Open-Source Builder

I build evidence-gated AI agent systems for mathematics, scientific research, and education—making model outputs auditable, reproducible, and safer to deploy. I also turn the engineering process into open-source tools and Chinese technical tutorials.

3250101086@zju.edu.cn GitHub · Ephemeral6 Knowledge Garden 01 · Profile From plausible answers to verifiable systems.

My work focuses on the infrastructure around foundation models: typed problem and evidence graphs, trusted verification boundaries, replayable execution, tool safety, and rigorous evaluation. The goal is not simply to make an agent answer—but to make its reasoning process inspectable and its failures useful.

127offline tests in the graph-native Math Agent 135deterministic fault and replay scenarios 12/12AgentFirewall guard tests passed 7/7demonstration attacks blocked 02 · Selected Work Open-source systems with inspectable evidence.

A focused selection across agent infrastructure, safety, knowledge systems, and scientific AI.

Agent Infrastructure Evidence-Gated Agent Stack

A graph-native mathematical agent and a general modeling harness built around typed state, evidence freshness, invariant-checked patches, trusted verifiers, and replayable audit trails.

Math Agent ↗ Modeling Harness ↗ Agent Safety AgentFirewall / AgentVault

A secure payment layer for AI agents on Monad, combining an MCP server, prompt-injection defenses, policy enforcement, session keys, and on-chain vault controls.

Repository ↗ Education · Knowledge Systems Knowledge Integrator

An LLM and knowledge-graph platform that integrates multiple textbooks, supports large heterogeneous documents, provides hybrid retrieval with citations, and incorporates teacher feedback.

Repository ↗ Scientific AI Micro-RAG & Computational Chemistry

Domain systems for microbiology retrieval and Text-to-SQL, plus an automation toolkit for molecular enumeration, 3D structure generation, and Gaussian workflows.

Micro-RAG ↗ CompChem Toolkit ↗ Technical Communication Engineering ideas into reusable methods

I write in Chinese about multi-agent systems, RAG, formal reasoning, evaluation, and agent safety. Bake Protocol is one example: a documented workflow for converting visually complex AI-generated HTML into editable presentation decks through selective rasterization.

Bake Protocol ↗ Proposed Kimi Collaboration Kimi Evidence Lab

A public, reproducible evaluation and teaching platform that connects the Kimi API to my existing Math Agent and Modeling Harness. It would compare bare-model and evidence-gated workflows across mathematics, scientific question answering, and knowledge retrieval—binding conclusions to traces, verifier outputs, latency, cost, and failure analysis.
